details: A paid 38-minute gate said green while 19 of 27 runs of the change's own new evals errored and were never judged, so the gate proved nothing about the change and nobody would have noticed without reading the notes.
failing_case: 23 Oct, wt/guard-batch, full bin/ci: "ci: eval record: 0 meaning grader(s) failed, 0 split votes, 19 not judged" followed by "ci: green"; the 19 were tune-* runs hitting max_turns 3.
pass_cases: A full bin/ci with any run not judged, or any grader failed, does not end "ci: green"; a run with all judged and passing still ends green.
reason: tests/test_gate_not_judged.py: test_a_failed_meaning_grader_exits_2_naming_the_case, test_an_errored_run_exits_2 (not judged -> exit 2), test_all_judged_and_passing_exits_0 (still green), test_bin_ci_does_not_end_green_on_a_non_zero_record_step. Fail at base, pass at head.
findings.summary: Full gate stays green when eval runs are not judged
